record.paper_title: Current work and open problems in the numerical analysis of Volterra functional equations with vanishing delays
record.original_question: For the weakly singular Volterra functional integro-differential equation u'(t) = a(t)u(t) + b(t)u(θ(t)) + g(t) + (V_αu)(t) + (V_{θ,α}u)(t), where (V_αu)(t) = \int_0^t (t-s)^{-α}K_0(t,s)u(s)\,ds and (V_{θ,α}u)(t) = \int_0^{θ(t)} (t-s)^{-α}K_1(t,s)u(s)\,ds with 0 < α < 1, does collocation by u_h \in S^{(0)}_m(I_h) attain the global order \|u-u_h\|_\infty \le C_m(r)N^{-(m+1-α)} on graded meshes t_n = (n/N)^r T when the collocation parameters satisfy \int_0^1 \prod_{i=1}^m (s-c_i)\,ds = 0 and r \ge (m+1-α)/(2-α)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.1 Assume that the given functions a, b, g, K0, K1 in the weakly singular VFIDE (3.3) have continuous derivatives of order m + 1, and let uh \in S(0) m (Ih) be the collocation solution to (3.3). If the collocation parameters {ci} in (2.2) satisfy ∫ 1 0 ∏m i=1 (s − ci)ds = 0 and if the mesh is chosen to be Ih = {tn := (n/N) rT (0 \le n \le N)}, with r = r(α) \ge (m + 1 − α)/(2 − α), then, for θ \in C^{m+1}(I) satisfying (N1) and (N2) and for all 0 <α< 1, \|u − uh\|∞ \le Cm(r)N −(m+1−α).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the linear weakly singular Volterra functional integro-differential equation
  u'(t) = a(t) u(t) + b(t) u(θ(t)) + g(t) + (V_α u)(t) + (V_{θ,α} u)(t),    t ∈ I := [0, T],
with initial condition u(0) = u_0, where
  (V_α u)(t)     = ∫_0^{t}    (t − s)^{−α} K_0(t, s) u(s) ds,
  (V_{θ,α} u)(t) = ∫_0^{θ(t)} (t − s)^{−α} K_1(t, s) u(s) ds,
and 0 < α < 1. Assume the coefficient functions a, b, g and the kernels K_0, K_1 have continuous derivatives of order m + 1 on their respective domains. The vanishing delay θ ∈ C^{m+1}(I) satisfies
  (N1) θ(0) = 0 and 0 < θ(t) < t for all t ∈ (0, T];
  (N2) θ is strictly increasing on I with θ'(t) > 0.

Let N ≥ 1 and consider the graded mesh
  I_h = { t_n := (n/N)^r T : 0 ≤ n ≤ N },
with grading exponent r ≥ 1. Let σ_n := (t_n, t_{n+1}], and fix collocation parameters 0 ≤ c_1 < c_2 < ⋯ < c_m ≤ 1, generating the collocation points t_{n,i} := t_n + c_i (t_{n+1} − t_n). Define the piecewise polynomial space
  S_m^{(0)}(I_h) := { v ∈ C(I) : v|_{σ_n} ∈ π_m for 0 ≤ n ≤ N − 1 },
where π_m denotes polynomials of degree ≤ m. Let u_h ∈ S_m^{(0)}(I_h) be the collocation solution determined by u_h(0) = u_0 and
  u_h'(t_{n,i}) = a(t_{n,i}) u_h(t_{n,i}) + b(t_{n,i}) u_h(θ(t_{n,i})) + g(t_{n,i}) + (V_α u_h)(t_{n,i}) + (V_{θ,α} u_h)(t_{n,i}).

Question. Assume the collocation parameters {c_i} satisfy
  ∫_0^1 ∏_{i=1}^{m} (s − c_i) ds = 0,
and that the grading exponent satisfies r ≥ (m + 1 − α)/(2 − α). Does the global error estimate
  ‖u − u_h‖_∞ ≤ C_m(r) N^{−(m+1−α)}
hold for every α ∈ (0, 1), with a constant C_m(r) independent of N?
artifact.category_tag: collocation methods for weakly singular Volterra equations
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a conjecture on the attainable global convergence order of piecewise polynomial collocation, on graded meshes with optimally chosen exponent, for weakly singular Volterra functional integro-differential equations with a vanishing delay. Related results have been obtained for delay Volterra integral equations with weakly singular kernels and for VIDEs without delay on graded meshes, and a 1997 Brunner conjecture on local superconvergence for proportional-delay VIEs has been resolved. However, no source located explicitly confirms or refutes this particular conjecture for the full weakly singular VFIDE in the stated S_m^{(0)} collocation setting with the precise grading bound r ≥ (m+1−α)/(2−α). The status is therefore taken to be unknown / likely still open.

status_evidence.title: Convergence analysis of collocation solutions for delay Volterra integral equations with weakly singular kernels
status_evidence.snippet: Convergence analysis on uniform and graded meshes for delay Volterra integral equations with weakly singular kernels.
status_evidence.claim: Related convergence results on graded meshes have been obtained for delay VIEs with weakly singular kernels, but the cited VFIDE conjecture is not stated as resolved.

status_evidence.title: Piecewise Polynomial Collocation Methods for Linear Volterra Integro-Differential Equations with Weakly Singular Kernels
status_evidence.snippet: Optimal-order convergence on graded meshes for weakly singular VIDEs without delay.
status_evidence.claim: Analogous optimal-order results exist for non-delay weakly singular VIDEs on graded meshes.

status_evidence.title: Theoretical and numerical analysis of a first-kind linear Volterra functional integral equation with weakly singular kernel and vanishing delay
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates a problem stated by H. Brunner concerning first-kind VFIEs with weakly singular kernel and proportional delay.
status_evidence.claim: Other Brunner conjectures about weakly singular vanishing-delay Volterra equations have been addressed in recent literature, but this specific VFIDE conjecture is not reported as settled.
